title: Personality 2
note: Above leaf_personality_a2 (kind, honest, rude, serious). The adjectives an adult uses about colleagues and friends. Not feelings-now — that is leaf_feelings_b1. First draft 2026-09-02. · 2026-09-04 B1 loop: the draft's word list was 24/36 REVIEW — twelve tiles were leaf_personality_a2's own words (reliable, generous, clever, calm, ambitious, selfish, lazy, shy, cheerful, serious, creative, curious) and twelve more were taught elsewhere earlier (patient, confident, understanding, mean, nervous, quiet, funny, fair, and four that leaf_self_b1 owns). Only twelve words were new. F7/F8: the recycled ones moved to a **You already know** review board (intro page 1) and the Match list was refilled with 24 character adjectives that are new at this position. · sentences 8 → 36, one gappable frame per lemma. E10: Use is use_mode rewrite, 12 items. · The frames page carried generic noun frames (I have a … / I need a …) on a pack of adjectives; they are adjective frames now, and the false-friend note moved from *sympathetic* (leaf_false_friends_b1 owns it, F2) to *sensible*, which is a tile here. · Pool-checked against everything taught before leaf_personality_b1 — 0 unknown types. · 2026-09-04: all twelve rewrite items marked a correct answer wrong — every one was an adjective whose `be` the swap could not supply. The prompt now carries is/are/was and the underline covers only the paraphrase. · 2026-09-05 B1 loop: sentence texture. 15 of 36 Use sentences were FLAT or THIN under check_sentence_texture.py. All 15 rewritten to make one clause move and carry two or more already-taught words. This leaf is at path slot 20, seventeen slots before b1_linkers, so five drafts written with `although` had to come back to `but` — the ceiling written up in DECISIONS.

intro.title: You will use these words in
frames: Nobody likes a … boss · *Nikdo nemá rád … šéfa*
intro.note: **sensible** does not mean *senzibilní*. It means **rozumný** — someone who makes good decisions. *Citlivý* is **sensitive**.
